model_selection.worker_memory_basis: Container memory cap per worker. ASR 6 GiB: the largest CPU table estimate (large-v3 int8) plus the 20 % RAM headroom fits; the live worker RAM limit clamps it on smaller hosts. Media 1 GiB as validated end to end.
model_selection.worker_overhead_basis: loader minimum; measured peak RSS already includes the Python runtime

envelope_field_basis.worker_peak_ram_bytes: max peak RSS of completed current-build records at a 2 GiB cap
envelope_field_basis.validated_max_duration_seconds: longest completed fixture below any worker failure

gpu_evidence.method: docker run --gpus all on the CUDA release candidate (nvidia-smi and ctranslate2 inside the container)
gpu_evidence.name: NVIDIA RTX 3500 Ada Generation Laptop GPU

benchmarks.method: Owned DockerRuntime transcribe runs (network none, read-only, 65532:65532, 1 CPU, memory cap as listed); measurements are the ASR worker result document; CUDA VRAM is the host nvidia-smi memory.used peak minus the pre-run baseline. Raw records are not retained; record_sha256 is the sha256 of each raw JSONL record. bound_image_id is the local image the run used; only records bound to the current build feed envelopes.
benchmarks.fixture_generator: Synthetic speech from an original English text (bin/release_benchmarks.py) via ffmpeg flite (voice slt) inside the media image; no recordings
